sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Armored Warrior (甲冑武者) is a foreigner who came from far across the southern seas in search of the waters of rejuvenation to cure his son's illness.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text:
First Encounter | Armoured Warrior: For the sake of my son... Put down your sword.
Wolf: I will not.
Armoured Warrior: You are a fool.
Deathblow Without Knocking Him off the Edge | Armoured Warrior:
Your sword cannot pierce my armor. Why do you not understand?
My armor is immovable. I cannot fall.
Ugh! Trying to topple me off the edge?! Do not kick my prized armor!
Upon Killing Wolf | Armoured Warrior: Strike me all you like, I am unbreakable. My son will receive the waters...
Upon Falling off the Edge | Armoured Warrior: Roberrrtttt!
